messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: naming & killing branches
parts:
Unless someone has a better idea, I think we should stick to
the following naming conventions for branches:

feature/issue-<NUMBER>-<description>
hotfix/ ...

where <NUMBER> is the issue number in the issue tracker and <description>
is a very short description.

I'm having a hard time trolling through our branches to see if
they line up to issues with all the different naming conventions.

Also, I think we need to make a pass and kill all the old branches
that we're either no longer using or that have been merged.

- Bob
